item.tib: rnam dag pad ma klong yangs kyi dbang khrid ge sar gzhon nu ngo mtshar snang ba'i dga' ston
item.coloph: zhes rnam dag pad ma klong yangs kyi dbang khrid ge sar gzhon nu/ skal ldan snang ba'i dga' ston ces bya ba 'di yang / mkhan rin po che bsod nams blo gros nas mdzad pa'i dbang khrid cig 'dug pa de la bon gyi spyan ldan chen po mkhas pa gnyos rgyal dang*/ 'gro mgon blo gros dang / bru ston rgyal (ba) rnams kyi phyag rgyun dang / cung tsam mi mthun pa thams cad/ sngar gyi mkhas grub de gsum gyi rjes su 'breng zhing / de min thams cad mkhan chen de nyid kyi gsung la gtsor bstan (brten)nas/ rnam dag rgyud dang cho ga'i gzhung don ci bzhin bsgrigs pa 'di yang / mkhan ming nyi ma bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal du 'bod pa bdag gis/ g.yen khams sel mdo las byung / bod skad du rdos can zhes bya ba/ sa mo phag lo'i 'bum 'gyur bzla (zla) ba'i 'dul rtsis tshes brgyad rje rin po che'i dus chen nyin sman ri'i bla brang du grub par bgyis pa'i dge des mnyam med bla ma'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig/
